title: StarDist
description: Segment cell nuclei in 2D fluorescence microscopy with StarDist's pretrained 2D_versatile_fluo model.

segment.title: Segment nuclei
segment.description: Run StarDist 2D_versatile_fluo on one 2D image channel and return the nucleus label image and a per-nucleus table.

image.description: One 2D TIFF, OME-TIFF or PNG image of fluorescent nuclei

channel.description: Channel or page to segment, counting from 1

probThresh.description: Object probability threshold (the model's tuned value by default)

nmsThresh.description: Overlap threshold of non-maximum suppression (the model's tuned value by default)

tiles.description: Tiles per image axis; 0 picks one tile per 1024 pixels
